title: Your Infrastructure Projects Just Got a Digital Fast-Track
description: The government has unveiled new digital tools to speed up big infrastructure projects across India. These tools, part of the PM Gati Shakti plan, help differe.

faq.q: What kind of projects are covered by PM Gati Shakti?
faq.a: It covers a wide range of infrastructure projects, including roads, railways, ports, airports, mass transport, waterways, and logistics infrastructure, along with social infrastructure like schools and hospitals.

faq.q: How does ULIP help ordinary people?
faq.a: By making logistics more efficient, ULIP helps reduce transportation costs and delivery times for goods, which can translate into lower prices for products and faster delivery of online orders for consumers.

faq.q: Is this a new budget allocation?
faq.a: While PM Gati Shakti projects receive funding, the recent news is more about a *policy decision* to use enhanced digital tools and better coordination to make the existing and future budget allocations for infrastructure more effective and efficient.

faq.q: How does this affect local businesses?
faq.a: Local businesses, especially small and medium enterprises (SMEs), can benefit from improved connectivity, faster movement of raw materials and finished goods, and potentially lower logistics costs, making them more competitive.

faq.q: What is the main goal of this digital push?
faq.a: The main goal is to improve India's multi-modal connectivity (connecting different modes of transport like road, rail, air, sea) and logistics efficiency, thereby reducing logistics costs and boosting economic growth and competitiveness.
